title: docs: simplify privacy and provider documentation
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed model-specific Claude and GLM 5.3 routing descriptions from the Privacy Policy and Service Providers page; both retain their general disclosures about providers and fallbacks. Removed pending route-review notes from the internal draft DPA and corrected its references. Documentation maintenance guidance now calls for updating affected public documents and their dates when statements become inaccurate, while keeping routing evidence and unresolved reviews in PRs or issues.
